Costing.title: Profitability
Costing.body: Project profitability shows a project’s revenue, cost and margin, computed from recorded time, expenses and purchases. The budget-versus-actual comparison and the component breakdown show where every figure comes from. When a cost rate is missing the panel says so instead of computing with zero; without revenue the margin stays empty rather than wrong.
